Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a two-vehicle collision in a commercial parking lot in Houston, Texas. Upon arrival,
the vehicles were stationary with visible front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle and rear-quarter damage to Driver 2's
vehicle. The damage pattern was consistent with the impact described by both drivers. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2
reversed into the front of the vehicle while Driver 1 was proceeding slowly through a parking aisle. Driver 2
acknowledged the contact and did not dispute the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses on scene gave
statements matching this account, and photographs taken at the scene were reviewed. Officers confirmed that
Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which was
observed to be swollen, and was evaluated by emergency medical personnel. Driver 1 presented proof of insurance
listing Driver 1 as a named driver on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported or observed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
